newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index loses 0.006pts to 103.158.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index loses 0.006pts to 103.158.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds lost 0.006 points in Monday's trading to 103.158 bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.257 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, lost 0.014 points to 99.477, points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.196 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 lost 0.630 points to 1,037.884.
